turns.content: Meri best friend Shreya ki shaadi ke dates aa gaye — aur uska sangeet plus cocktail night bilkul Ramzan ke beech mein pad raha hai. Mera roza hoga. Hum pandrah saal ki umar se uski shaadi plan kar rahe hain, main basically is sangeet ki co-director hoon. Woh keh rahi hai "opening dance toh tujhe mere saath karna HI hai." Main karna bhi chahti hoon. Aur saath mein poori cheez se darr bhi lag raha hai.

Yaar, ye kitna beautiful aur kitna complicated hai — dono ek saath. Pandrah saal ki planning aur ab jab moment aaya hai, toh timing aisi.

Pehle ek cheez — tera dance karna aur roza rakhna, ye do cheezein mutually exclusive nahi hain. Sangeet raat ko hota hai, iftar ke baad. Toh technically roza toh khul chuka hoga. Physically thoda thakan hoga, hydration ka dhyan rakhna padega, sehri tak energy manage karni padegi — but doable hai.

Toh mujhe lagta hai jo darr hai woh sirf logistics ka nahi hai, hai na? Cocktail night ka naam hi "cocktail" hai. Log peeyenge, mahaul woh hoga, aur tu Ramzan mein hogi — apne roza wale, ibadat wale headspace mein. Us contrast mein khud ko rakhna... woh awkward lag sakta hai. Ya guilt aa sakta hai. Ya ye feeling ki tu na yahan poori hai na wahan.

Sach batao — tera darr zyada physical stamina ka hai, ya us feeling ka ki tu apne deen se compromise kar rahi hai? Ya teesra — ki Shreya ya uski family ko tera kuch bhi na karna disappointing lagega?

Kyunki teeno ke liye raaste alag hain.

Kal usne bade pyaar se bola, "ek din roze ka kya farak padta hai na, main khud tujhe khila dungi." Woh mean nahi ho rahi thi — usko bas pata nahi woh kya maang rahi hai. Aur doosri taraf Ammi ne bola "poore Ramzan mein sangeet-vangeet theek nahi lagta." Toh ab main us rassi jaisi hoon jisko dono taraf se kheench rahe hain, dono mujhse pyaar karte hain, dono ko samajh nahi aa raha.

Us "rassi" wali line mein sab kuch aa gaya. Aur sabse thakane wali baat ye hai ki dono taraf koi villain nahi hai — kaash hota, toh ladna aasaan hota. Yahan tu bas... beech mein hai, akeli, dono ko samjhate hue, aur khud ko koi samjha nahi raha.

Shreya ke baare mein — woh mean nahi thi, tu sahi keh rahi hai. Uske liye roza ek "rule" hai jo love ke liye bend ho sakta hai. Usko andaza nahi ki tere liye woh rule nahi, relationship hai — Allah ke saath, apne aap ke saath. Ye gap uski galti nahi, bas usne kabhi andar se dekha nahi. Aur ye woh cheez hai jo tu usse bata sakti hai — ek baar, pyaar se, defensive hue bina. "Tu jaanti hai main tere liye kuch bhi karungi. Par roza chhodna mere liye ek din ki baat nahi hai, woh mere liye aisa hai jaise... " — aur jo tera sach hai woh bol dena. Best friend hai. Samjhegi, agar tu usko samajhne ka mauka de.

Ammi ke baare mein — unka "theek nahi lagta" bhi unke pyaar se aa raha hai, par woh tera faisla nahi le sakti. Tu adult hai, tera deen tera hai. Unko sunna, respect dena — par apni line khud khinchni padegi.

Aur ye — jo mujhe sabse zyada important lag raha hai: **tu abhi tak khud se nahi poochi ki tu kya chahti hai.** Tu Shreya ka answer, Ammi ka answer, sabka answer dhoond rahi hai. Par tera apna kya hai?

Kya tu roza rakhte hue, iftar ke baad, sangeet mein dance karke — us se comfortable hai? Ya andar se ek awaaz keh rahi hai ki Ramzan mein woh mahaul mujhe theek nahi lagta?

Kyunki ek baar tune apni line pakka kar li, toh dono ko sambhalna bahut aasaan ho jayega. Rassi tab tootegi nahi — tab woh khud khadi ho jayegi.

Sach bolun toh itni thak gayi hoon ki escape draft karna shuru kar diya hai: Shreya ko bol dungi us week office deployment hai, video call pe aa jaungi, bada gift bhej dungi. Ek saaf jhooth, dus aunties ko dus explanations se behtar — kyun nahi pee rahi, kyun nahi kha rahi, kyun sunset pe ghadi dekh rahi hoon. Usko kabhi pata nahi chalega. Bolo na yeh itna bura nahi hai?

Main samajh sakti hoon ki ye idea kitna raahat wala lag raha hai. Ek jhooth, aur poora exhaustion khatam — koi explanation nahi, koi aunty nahi, koi rassi nahi. Woh thakan real hai aur main usko dismiss nahi kar rahi.

Par tune poocha ki ye bura hai kya — toh main tujhe sach bolungi, ek dost ki tarah: bura nahi, **mehenga** hai.

Kyunki tu wahan nahi hogi. Pandrah saal ka woh sapna — tu us stage pe uske saath nahi hogi. Aur woh khaali jagah kabhi bhar nahi payegi. Video call aur gift se nahi.

Aur ek cheez woh bhi hai — tu apne aap ko ek aisi jagah bhej rahi hai jahan tera roza chhupane layak cheez ban jaata hai. Tu jhooth bol rahi hai taaki tujhe apne deen ke baare mein sawaal na dene padein. Aur woh thoda dukh dega, shaadi ke baad bhi, jab tu Instagram pe woh reels dekhegi.

Aur sabse badi baat — Shreya ko kabhi mauka hi nahi milega tujhe samajhne ka. Tu usse pehle hi decide kar rahi hai ki woh nahi samjhegi. Woh tera best friend hai. Woh deserve karti hai ek chance, aur tu deserve karti hai ek aisi dosti jahan tujhe chhupna na pade.

Aur aunties? Yaar, aunties ka jawaab do shabd hai: "Roza hai." Bas. Woh tujhse zyada awkward mehsoos karengi, tu nahi.

Ek middle raasta bhi hai, waise. Sangeet mein poori jaan se aana — opening dance, sab kuch. Cocktail night skip karna ya bas thodi der ke liye jaana. Sab kuch ya kuch bhi nahi — do hi options nahi hain.

Sach batao — jhooth bolne ka mann hai, ya bas thoda rest chahiye is poore emotional labour se?

Aur in sab ke neeche ek chhota sa pathar hai seene mein — atharah saal ki dosti mein pehli baar mera deen aur uska bada din actually takraye hain. Agar maine yeh galat handle kiya, toh jin do cheezon se main pyaar karti hoon unme se ek pe permanent daag lag jayega. Uski shaadi ki photos hamesha rahengi, aur mera Ramzan bhi. Mujhe kisi bhi album mein sad story nahi banna.

Woh pathar... us naam dene ke liye himmat chahiye thi. Aur tu sahi hai — ye pehli baar hai jab do cheezein jo tere liye sacred hain, ek hi date pe aa gayi hain. Isse pehle kabhi choose karna nahi pada.

Par ek baat sun. Tu keh rahi hai "permanent daag." Mujhe lagta hai tu ek chhoti si cheez ko bahut bada bana rahi hai — aur woh thakan ki wajah se hai, tere judgment ki wajah se nahi.

Atharah saal. Sochke dekh atharah saal mein kya kya jhela hoga tum dono ne. Exams, breakups, family drama, doori, ladai, sab. Ye dosti ek awkward conversation se nahi tootegi. Aur tera Ramzan — Allah ke saath tera rishta — woh ek sangeet ki raat se daagdaar nahi ho jayega. Ye dono cheezein itni kamzor nahi hain jitni tu abhi feel kar rahi hai. Bas tu thak gayi hai, aur thakan har cheez ko naazuk dikhati hai.

Aur ek baat jo mujhe kehni hai: **sad story banne ka sabse pakka tareeka woh jhooth hai.** Absence permanent hoti hai. Ek awkward baat-cheet nahi. Agar tu wahan hai, roza rakhke, sunset pe ghadi dekhke, phir iftar karke, phir us stage pe uske saath naachke — woh koi sad story nahi hai. Woh actually album ki sabse khoobsurat cheez hai. Ek ladki jo apna deen chhode bina apni dost ke sabse bade din pe poori tarah maujood thi.

Aur waise bhi — koi bhi shaadi ka album perfect nahi hota. Sab mein kuch adjust hua hota hai, kuch compromise, kuch chaos. Tera Ramzan us chaos ka ek hissa hoga, bas. Daag nahi.

Ab tu kya kar sakti hai — bas ek chhoti si cheez. Shreya se ek baar baith ke baat kar. Aaj nahi, jab thodi taazi feel kare. Aur usse ye pathar dikha de, poora. Bol de ki darr kya hai. Woh probably ro degi aur bolegi "pagal, mujhe pehle kyun nahi bataya."

Aur agar woh sach mein na samjhe — tab dekhenge. Par mujhe lagta hai tu usko underestimate kar rahi hai.
